parameters.name: world_frame
parameters.doc: Parent frame for position, attitude, depth, odometry and TF.

parameters.name: base_link_frame
parameters.doc: Child/body frame; sensors are rotated into it.

parameters.name: publish_tf
parameters.doc: Publish world_frame -> base_link_frame on /tf.

parameters.name: imu_frame_fallback
parameters.doc: Frame assumed when an IMU sample has an empty frame_id; empty rejects.

parameters.name: fog_frame_fallback
parameters.doc: Frame assumed when a FOG sample has an empty frame_id; empty rejects.

parameters.name: dvl_frame_fallback
parameters.doc: Frame assumed when a DVL sample has an empty frame_id; empty rejects.

parameters.name: mount_refresh_period
parameters.doc: How often the overseer re-reads sensor mounts from TF and republishes them.

parameters.name: parameters_loaded
parameters.doc: Set by the overseer once every parameter and mount is loaded; the estimator starts then.

parameters.name: imu_mount_valid
parameters.doc: True once the overseer has resolved the IMU mount from TF; samples are rejected until then.

parameters.name: imu_translation
parameters.doc: IMU origin in base_link.

parameters.name: imu_rotation
parameters.doc: IMU to base_link rotation, quaternion w x y z.

parameters.name: fog_mount_valid
parameters.doc: True once the overseer has resolved the FOG mount from TF; samples are rejected until then.

parameters.name: fog_translation
parameters.doc: FOG origin in base_link.

parameters.name: fog_rotation
parameters.doc: FOG to base_link rotation, quaternion w x y z.

parameters.name: dvl_mount_valid
parameters.doc: True once the overseer has resolved the DVL mount from TF; samples are rejected until then.

parameters.name: dvl_translation
parameters.doc: DVL origin in base_link.

parameters.name: dvl_rotation
parameters.doc: DVL to base_link rotation, quaternion w x y z.

parameters.name: depth_frame
parameters.doc: Frame of depth samples outside world_frame, learned from the depth topic; they are moved into world_frame with depth_translation and depth_rotation.

parameters.name: depth_mount_valid
parameters.doc: True once the overseer has resolved depth_frame in world_frame from TF; samples in that frame are rejected until then.

parameters.name: depth_translation
parameters.doc: depth_frame origin in world_frame.

parameters.name: depth_rotation
parameters.doc: depth_frame to world_frame rotation, quaternion w x y z.

parameters.name: base_rate
parameters.doc: Input task rate; Subscribe keeps one message per step, so well above the fastest sensor (FOG about 475 Hz). Build-time: the build reads it, the overseer only checks it.

parameters.name: estimator_rate
parameters.doc: Estimator task rate, a whole divisor of base_rate. Build-time.

parameters.name: parameter_rate
parameters.doc: How often the model reads its parameters, a whole divisor of estimator_rate. Build-time.

parameters.name: input_ring_capacity
parameters.doc: Sample sets the input task can hold while the estimator task is busy. Build-time array size.

parameters.name: checkpoint_capacity
parameters.doc: Checkpoint ring size. Build-time array size.

parameters.name: input_history_capacity
parameters.doc: Replay input ring size. Build-time array size.

parameters.name: queue_capacity
parameters.doc: Per-sensor reorder buffer size. Build-time array size.

parameters.name: frequency
parameters.doc: Publication rate, rounded to a whole number of base steps.

parameters.name: reorder_delay
parameters.doc: Hold queued measurements this long so out-of-order samples sort by stamp.

parameters.name: max_queue_size
parameters.doc: Runtime per-sensor reorder cap; at most queue_capacity.

parameters.name: max_measurements_per_cycle
parameters.doc: Count cap per step; zero means no cap.

parameters.name: max_processing_fraction
parameters.doc: Wall-time budget per publication period as a fraction; zero means no budget.

parameters.name: max_stamp_lead
parameters.doc: Samples stamped further ahead than this are rejected.

parameters.name: history_length
parameters.doc: Replay window; later samples restore a checkpoint and replay.

parameters.name: max_measurement_lag
parameters.doc: Older DVL/depth beyond history are fused now with lag added to R; older still are rejected.

parameters.name: max_prediction_dt
parameters.doc: Largest single prediction step.

parameters.name: checkpoint_stride
parameters.doc: Minimum filter time between checkpoints.

parameters.name: sensor_timeouts
parameters.doc: Max age of an accepted IMU, FOG, DVL, depth sample before diagnostics warn.

parameters.name: publication_mode
parameters.doc: predict propagates the delayed estimate; queued_updates previews queued observations.

parameters.name: reuse_preview_corrections
parameters.doc: Reuse a matching preview prefix instead of recomputing it.

parameters.name: max_position_correction_rate
parameters.doc: Horizontal correction rate that reaches odometry; zero disables.

parameters.name: outage_motion_time_constant
parameters.doc: Decay of the held rate and acceleration once the IMU is lost; zero disables.

parameters.name: outage_velocity_time_constant
parameters.doc: Decay of the held velocity once the IMU and DVL are lost; zero disables.

parameters.name: outage_commit_lag
parameters.doc: With every sensor lost, how far behind a publication the filter is committed; zero disables.

parameters.name: position_correction_max_gap
parameters.doc: Publication gap beyond which the rate limit snaps to the estimate.

parameters.name: vectornav_imu_config
parameters.doc: VectorNav fields to fuse. 15 booleans in robot_localization order: pos XYZ, attitude RPY, lin vel XYZ, ang vel XYZ, lin accel XYZ. Unsupported fields are rejected.

parameters.name: dvl_twist_config
parameters.doc: DVL fields to fuse. 15 booleans in robot_localization order: pos XYZ, attitude RPY, lin vel XYZ, ang vel XYZ, lin accel XYZ. Unsupported fields are rejected.

parameters.name: fog_twist_config
parameters.doc: FOG fields to fuse. 15 booleans in robot_localization order: pos XYZ, attitude RPY, lin vel XYZ, ang vel XYZ, lin accel XYZ. Unsupported fields are rejected.

parameters.name: depth_pose_config
parameters.doc: Depth fields to fuse. 15 booleans in robot_localization order: pos XYZ, attitude RPY, lin vel XYZ, ang vel XYZ, lin accel XYZ. Unsupported fields are rejected.

parameters.name: imu_orientation_axis_multiplier
parameters.doc: Per-axis covariance multiplier on the VN gravity-direction (roll, pitch, yaw rows). Larger weighs less.

parameters.name: imu_angular_velocity_axis_multiplier
parameters.doc: Per-axis covariance multiplier on VN body rate X Y Z.

parameters.name: imu_acceleration_axis_multiplier
parameters.doc: Per-axis covariance multiplier on VN acceleration X Y Z.

parameters.name: dvl_axis_multiplier
parameters.doc: Per-axis covariance multiplier on DVL velocity X Y Z.

parameters.name: fog_axis_multiplier
parameters.doc: Per-axis covariance multiplier on FOG rate X Y Z.

parameters.name: imu_covariance_multiplier
parameters.doc: Covariance multiplier on all VN groups.

parameters.name: imu_orientation_covariance_multiplier
parameters.doc: Extra multiplier on VN orientation covariance.

parameters.name: imu_rate_covariance_multiplier
parameters.doc: Extra multiplier on VN rate covariance (provisional pool weighting, not calibration).

parameters.name: imu_acceleration_covariance_multiplier
parameters.doc: Extra multiplier on VN acceleration covariance.

parameters.name: fog_covariance_multiplier
parameters.doc: Covariance multiplier on FOG.

parameters.name: dvl_covariance_multiplier
parameters.doc: Covariance multiplier on DVL.

parameters.name: depth_covariance_multiplier
parameters.doc: Covariance multiplier on depth.

parameters.name: covariance_floor
parameters.doc: Smallest variance after conditioning.

parameters.name: default_orientation_variance
parameters.doc: Used when the VN orientation covariance is unspecified.

parameters.name: default_angular_velocity_variance
parameters.doc: Used when the VN rate covariance is unspecified.

parameters.name: default_acceleration_variance
parameters.doc: Used when the VN acceleration covariance is unspecified.

parameters.name: default_fog_variance
parameters.doc: Used when the FOG covariance is unspecified.

parameters.name: default_dvl_variance
parameters.doc: Used when the DVL covariance is unspecified.

parameters.name: default_depth_variance
parameters.doc: Used when the depth covariance is unspecified.

parameters.name: imu_orientation_covariance_coordinates
parameters.doc: Coordinates of the VN orientation covariance.

parameters.name: gravity_direction_variance_floor
parameters.doc: Variance added to the gravity-direction covariance.

parameters.name: initialize_tilt_from_imu
parameters.doc: Align gravity once at automatic startup.

parameters.name: vectornav_tilt_correction_frequency
parameters.doc: Cap on VN tilt corrections; zero is every sample.

parameters.name: imu_acceleration_update
parameters.doc: consider keeps position and attitude out of the acceleration correction; joint is the original.

parameters.name: gravitational_acceleration
parameters.doc: Local gravity used in the raw acceleration prediction.

parameters.name: imu_acceleration_bias
parameters.doc: Initial accelerometer bias.

parameters.name: imu_acceleration_bias_density
parameters.doc: Bias random-walk density.

parameters.name: imu_acceleration_bias_variance
parameters.doc: Initial bias variance.

parameters.name: imu_acceleration_bias_rotation_variance
parameters.doc: Extra bias decorrelation with tilt rate.

parameters.name: imu_angular_acceleration_time_constant
parameters.doc: Lever-arm angular acceleration derivative filter.

parameters.name: imu_angular_acceleration_noise_bandwidth
parameters.doc: Bound on the derivative-noise bandwidth.

parameters.name: process_noise_diag
parameters.doc: Continuous-time densities for position, quaternion (3 body angular, 1 unused), velocity, rate, acceleration.

parameters.name: reset_covariance_diag
parameters.doc: Variances after a reset or startup.

parameters.name: initial_quaternion_tolerance
parameters.doc: set_pose is rejected when its quaternion norm differs from 1 by more.

parameters.name: imu_yaw_rate_fallback
parameters.doc: VN yaw rate stands in while the FOG is lost.

parameters.name: imu_yaw_rate_fallback_variance
parameters.doc: Variance added to the VN yaw rate in fallback.

parameters.name: imu_quaternion_norm_tolerance
parameters.doc: A VN quaternion off unit norm by more is rejected.

parameters.name: scalar_fog_correction
parameters.doc: Use the linear scalar update when one FOG axis is enabled.

parameters.name: dvl_rejection_threshold
parameters.doc: Innovation gate on DVL, in standard deviations; zero disables.

parameters.name: depth_rejection_threshold
parameters.doc: Innovation gate on depth; zero disables.

parameters.name: tilt_rejection_threshold
parameters.doc: Innovation gate on VN tilt; zero disables.

parameters.name: fog_rejection_threshold
parameters.doc: FOG vs VN rate gate; zero disables.

parameters.name: fog_vn_rate_tolerance
parameters.doc: Allowed FOG minus VN rate error added to the gate variance.

parameters.name: vn_rate_pairing_window
parameters.doc: Largest stamp gap for pairing a FOG sample with the VN rate.

parameters.name: gate_recovery_time
parameters.doc: Rejected samples this long trigger recovery checks.

parameters.name: gate_consistency_stddev
parameters.doc: Agreement floors for recovery: IMU tilt, FOG, DVL, depth.

parameters.name: dvl_frozen_sample_limit
parameters.doc: Identical consecutive DVL samples before they are rejected; zero disables.

parameters.name: dvl_sigma_jump_ratio
parameters.doc: Reported sigma over the recent median that marks lock loss; zero disables.

parameters.name: dvl_sigma_min_history
parameters.doc: Samples of sigma history needed before the jump test runs.

parameters.name: gate_reacquire_max_scale
parameters.doc: Widest the gate gets after an outage, as a multiple of the threshold.

parameters.name: gate_consistency_threshold
parameters.doc: Window fit residual allowed per degree of freedom for samples to count as agreeing.

parameters.name: gate_reacquire_samples
parameters.doc: Agreeing samples needed to reacquire after an outage.

parameters.name: gate_recovery_samples
parameters.doc: Agreeing samples needed to recover after rejections.

parameters.name: gate_min_recovery_window
parameters.doc: Shortest window of samples compared for agreement while recovering.

parameters.name: gate_flap_factor
parameters.doc: Recovery time multiplier after a recent short rejection.

parameters.name: heading_std_warning
parameters.doc: Heading standard deviation that raises a warning.

parameters.name: position_offset_warning
parameters.doc: Unpublished position offset that raises a warning.

parameters.name: diagnostics_period
parameters.doc: Diagnostics publication period.

parameters.name: clock_stall_timeout
parameters.doc: Wall time without a diagnostics tick before the clock is reported stalled.

parameters.name: publish_debug_diagnostics
parameters.doc: Add queue age, filter lag, innovation and correction norms.
